profile.headline: Software Engineer at Atlassian | Code2040 Fellow
profile.summary: I have strong interests in product management, machine learning, fintech, and full stack development. To learn more about me please visit my personal website at http://www.sergiogomezjr.com

positions.title: Fellow
positions.description: The fellowship program is an intensive career accelerator for top tech talent. It connects ambitious, high-performing students with top companies in the Bay Area as well as providing leadership development, technical workshops, and networking opportunities. One of 135 accepted students in 2018's fellows class, applicant pool contained over 4000 candidates.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: We are a goal-orientated company delivering unique web solutions based out of Charlotte, North Carolina. We launch our clients to the top of their industries through custom web design, application development, and internet marketing.

positions.title: Growth Marketing Intern
positions.description:
• Strategically assess growth and performance metrics to improve, change and/or help design new growth strategies
• Selected from a pool of thousands of candidates to work closely with the leaders of RippleMatch’s Marketing Team
• Leverage various growth strategies and tools including social media, email marketing, presentations,  and peer/faculty member networking to grow the user base and awareness on campus

positions.title: Google Student Innovator - Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
positions.description:
• Member of a select team of 200 students operating as GCP advocates for their University 
• Report directly to management teams working with Google to provide real-time feedback and inform ongoing product development 
• Organize events and document best practices to contribute to nationwide Student Innovator network
• Promote Google Cloud Platform's success opportunities with campus peers and faculty

positions.title: Expansion Analyst Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented a MySQL database that tracked a variety of attributes for multiple products, including transactional volume, date of arrival, date of purchase, product dependencies, employee identification numbers
• Database saved an estimated 340 man-hours, resulting in an annual saving of $8,000
• Developed Python program that analyzed geographical locations for maximum market share acquirability
• Generated opportunities to improve efficiency and productivity by mining transactional data, insights were presented to senior management in weekly reports; resulted in a 9% increase in average order value

honors.title: Dean's Honor List

honors.title: James Jolly Scholarship
honors.description: The scholarship allowed me to attend the 81st John O. Moseley leadership school. A week long school that incorporates the Social-Change Model, focusing on community, group and self development.
honors.issuer: Issued by Sigma Alpha Epsilon Fraternity · Jun 2016

organizations.name: Roebling Group
organizations.position: Portfolio Manager: Quantitative Investment Strategies · Aug 2016 - Present
organizations.description:
• Developed market monitors for EPI, EWW, EWP and XLU; assigned an internal rating based on the expected ability to monetize the trade; economic reports summarized key drivers and relevant risk metrics of the position
• Developed a quantitative model to backtest market neutral trading strategies; dynamically generated a PnL diagram of the trade and outputted various risk metrics including Max-drawdown and Sharpe ratio
